person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and refers to Mitch and the other characters in the third person. Most Goodreads quotations are dialogue or nondiagnostic fragments; q03158 supplies local third-person evidence, and none contains narratorial first- or second-person language. The authorized Penguin opening sustains third-person narration across several chapters and focal characters, while EBSCO explicitly establishes the same structure for all forty-one chapters; BookRags independently corroborates it. Shifts among character viewpoints are focalization shifts within third person, not alternating grammatical persons. The authorized excerpt does not cover the entire novel, but the whole-book structural evidence resolves that scope limitation, and no credible contrary evidence was found.
